meta.title: 读书给不了你的：实践感悟与场景风险
meta.title_en: What Books Can Never Give You: Hands-On Insight and Real-World Risk

scenes.title_cn: 三年前我的答案：实践感悟
scenes.title_en: Three years ago, I'd say: hands-on insight
scenes.context: 讲者开场提问「读了再多的书也无法给到你的是什么」，回忆三年前的答案：不亲手实践等于不知道，读书给不了实践感悟；但深度思考后他发现有别的东西——知和行之间有一个「场景」。
sentences: 读了再多的书，也无法给到你的是什么？
What can books never give you, no matter how many you read?
读了再多的书：no matter how many books you read
书读了再多，如果不亲手实践一下，那还是等于不知道。
No matter how much you read, without practicing it yourself, you still don't really know.
亲手实践：practice it yourself
知和行之间，有一个叫做场景的东西。
Between knowing and doing, there is something called the scenario.
场景：scenario
paraphrase: 读书 ≠ 知道 → 要亲手实践
Reading isn't knowing; you have to practice it yourself.
知和行之间还隔着一层场景
There's another layer between knowing and doing: the scenario.
scenes.speak: What can books never give you, no matter how many you read? No matter how much you read, without practicing it yourself, you still don't really know. Between knowing and doing, there is something called the scenario.

scenes.title_cn: 场景有风险，就不是懒能解决
scenes.title_en: When the scenario carries risk, laziness isn't the problem
scenes.context: 讲者区分场景风险：无风险时做不到只是懒，下班累死看书还是追热播剧，克服懒字即可；但高风险场景——做错被炸断腿、房产被银行收走全家露宿街头、兄弟散伙自谋出路——不是克服懒惰能解决的。
sentences: 如果场景没有什么风险，知道但做不到，那其实就是懒了。
If the scenario has no real risk, knowing but not doing is just laziness.
知道但做不到：knowing but not doing
下班后到家累死了，看书学习还是看热播电视剧？
You drag home dead tired after work: study, or binge the trending drama?
热播电视剧：trending drama
如果做错选择，抵押出去的房产证就会被银行收走，全家露宿街头。
If you choose wrong, the bank seizes your mortgaged deed, and your whole family ends up on the street.
露宿街头：end up on the street
paraphrase: 无风险做不到 → 归因于懒
When there's no risk, not doing it comes down to laziness.
高风险做错 → 无法靠自律解决
When the stakes are high, a wrong choice can't be fixed by willpower.
scenes.speak: If the scenario has no real risk, knowing but not doing is just laziness. You drag home dead tired after work: study, or binge the trending drama? If you choose wrong, the bank seizes your mortgaged deed, and your whole family ends up on the street.

scenes.title_cn: 书里安全，现实残酷：逆境才是分水岭
scenes.title_en: Books are safe; reality is brutal. Adversity draws the line
scenes.context: 讲者总结：书给不了绝望时的真实感受和做艰难决定时的心态；书里的世界安全，现实残酷，有些苦只能自己扛。身处困境时把它当作天降大任前的考验，你在逆境下的表现才是把人与芸芸众生区别开的标志。
sentences: 书可以给你很多道理，但唯独给不了你的是面临绝望时的真实感受。
Books can give you plenty of lessons, but never the real feeling of staring into despair.
面临绝望：staring into despair
书里的世界是安全的，现实的世界是残酷的。
The world inside books is safe; the real world is brutal.
残酷的：brutal
你在逆境下的表现，才是把你和其他芸芸众生区别出来的标志。
How you perform under adversity is what sets you apart from the crowd.
芸芸众生：the crowd
paraphrase: 书的极限 → 给不了体感
Books have a limit: they can't transmit felt experience.
绝望要自己扛 → 逆境定高下
Despair is yours to carry; adversity decides who you are.
scenes.speak: Books can give you plenty of lessons, but never the real feeling of staring into despair. The world inside books is safe; the real world is brutal. How you perform under adversity is what sets you apart from the crowd.

practice: 表达「书给不了实践感悟」
Books can't hand you hands-on insight.
I know it, but I just can't do it.
One wrong move and everything falls apart.
Adversity is where people are truly sorted out.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Between knowledge and action there's a thing called scene.
✓ 地道说法：Between knowing and doing, there's something called the scenario.
scene 指风景/画面，此处表「情境」用 scenario 或 situation 更贴切。
✕ 直译腔：Overcome a lazy word and you can solve it.
✓ 地道说法：Getting past laziness is all it takes.
「克服一个懒字」直译成 lazy word 是中式表达，英文里直接说 laziness。
✕ 直译腔：The house certificate is collected away by the bank.
✓ 地道说法：The bank seizes the mortgaged deed.
银行收回抵押物用 seize / repossess，collect 不地道。
✕ 直译腔：Your performance under adversity distinguishes you from all beings.
✓ 地道说法：How you perform under adversity sets you apart from the crowd.
all beings 有宗教腔，从人群中区分开用 set apart from the crowd。
shifts: 读了很多书就等于知道，知道就等于能做到
知和行之间隔着场景，知道不等于做到
做不到一定是懒，逼自己就行
先看场景风险：无风险是懒，高风险需要勇气和心态
书里的世界安全、现实残酷，逆境表现才是分水岭
footer_notes: ASR 转写已按语境校正（如「拆摊专家」校正为电影《拆弹专家》、「十字交臂」校正为「失之交臂」、「降大人前」校正为「降大任于你之前」、「云音终身」校正为「芸芸众生」、「七苦无遗」按语境校正为「属于自己的苦，只能自己扛」）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
